title: Chapter 488
paragraphs: Chapter 488
Episode 135: Brotherhood United (5)
Jin, Murakan, Diphus, and Joshua lifted the masks they had been wearing around their necks.
Kuzuzuzuk-! Crack!
In just about a minute, the noise and vibration of the battle had grown considerably.
Now that the decision had been made, they had to enter as soon as possible. Support would come immediately from Drakka and the 2nd Tower.

"However, since the situation has changed, we'll skip regrouping after gathering internal information, and as soon as we enter, we'll split up and check zones 4, 11, 17, and 19. I and the Black Knights will take zones 4 and 11, while the 4th and 12th Squadrons will take zones 17 and 19."

Zones 4 and 11 were relatively farther from the 2nd Tower than zones 17 and 19. Joshua was also very cautious. He threw a feint so that Jin and Diphus would be as unaware of the 2nd Tower as possible in this situation.

"Secure the ship's blueprint and destroy the most important resources. After at least one of these is achieved, survive and return to the main house. Also, if there's a high likelihood of being captured or killed by the enemy, prioritize escaping first. All other decisions will be left to your discretion."
"Understood."
Joshua extended his fist towards Jin and Diphus. The two looked at it for a moment before bumping it lightly.
"Good luck, my brothers."
"To think I'd see the day my older brother would wish us luck. Well, if we all return safely, let's have a drink together to celebrate, as promised to the youngest."
"Good luck, 2nd Squadron."
Joshua and the Black Knights entered the construction yard beyond the cave first. Jin, Murakan, and Diphus watched their backs for a short time.

"Ha! If it weren't for the kid poking my side, I could've turned that situation around. As soon as I get a little annoyed, he starts talking back? A 2nd Squadron like that. Murakan has died a lot, really. I always think that when things like this happen. He doesn't even wish me luck, you know?"
"Oh yeah, thanks for bearing with it."
"Lord Murakan, that guy's neck will be separated from his body before dawn today anyway."
"That's right, he's totally done for."
"Youngest, I take back what I said about being disappointed yesterday. It really was just as you said. Kinzelo did exceed our expectations, though."
Although there was no need to think about Joshua anymore, it was still necessary to thoroughly examine the situation after entering.
'I need to calculate when Kinzelo will attack the 2nd Tower. Going too fast or too slow compared to them is a problem. But I have to go later than Joshua.'
The key was to find the right opportunity between Kinzelo and Joshua competing at the 2nd Tower.
Now it was time for improvisation.
"Support troops will arrive within 30 minutes at the latest. They may have already arrived."
Considering the distance, it would take at least 30 minutes for the dragons to fly to the Sota Desert.
"If that cube you mentioned is here as well, that's possible."
The space-time device. An unidentified cube used by Midor Elner in the Gaipa Military Road.

Jin had already shared the information about it with Diphus. After all, the survivors of the Gaipa Army had all directly witnessed the space-time device, so it wasn't particularly meaningful information to keep exclusive.

"In my opinion, there's a high possibility that it's also in the construction site. There's a chance that Joshua received related information from Vigo or his mother while he was here, so it's a good idea to assume they're aware of it and act accordingly."
Since even Sandra Zipple was aware of the existence of the space-time device known to the other three major forces, there was no need to hide it.
The reason Sandra Zipple was so angry when Midor Elnar, blinded by revenge in the Gaipa Army, used the space-time device was none other than this.

Originally, the device was supposed to be revealed for the first time in a more critical moment. For example, when directly striking the headquarters of Runcandel or forcing a large force to kneel. Midor thought that she could kill Jin and the enemies, so there would be no evidence left.
"Anyway, we'll have to join forces with Kinzelo for a while."
Instead of going to the area assigned by Joshua after entering, Jin decided to slaughter the Jipils with Kinzelo first.
"We need to deal with as many of them as possible, especially those from the 2nd Tower."
"Because our forces will be reduced when we enter the 2nd Tower, right? Especially if the space-time device exists there."
As Diphus replied, it was necessary to reduce the Zipple forces as much as possible due to the space-time device.
Kinzelo was also well aware of this fact, which is why he was carrying out such a large-scale terrorist attack. It wasn't just for the convenience of entering the 2nd Tower.
"That's correct."
"Ah, my head hurts! So, in summary, kid, you're saying this: we just have to go in and kill all the Zipple guys, right?"
"Well, that's right, but don't transform into your true form and save your strength. If it becomes known that you or I are here, the level of reinforcement could change. Anyway, let's get in there."
The cave led to Area 6 of the construction site.
As they entered, they first saw collapsed facilities, raging flames spreading everywhere, and enemy tribesmen who laughed vulgarly like third-rate villains while slaughtering the administrators.
"Die, die! You tasteless humans!"
"From today on, this place will be taken over by us Kinzelo!"
"Please, spare me!"
Jin and his party hid among the devices, columns, and pipes for a moment and watched them. It seemed that Joshua's group had already moved to another location.
'Zipple is indeed impressive.'
Although it was broken and burning, seeing the underground construction site's scenery firsthand made him feel amazed once again. Area 6 alone was filled with countless parts and machine devices.
At a glance, it seemed there were dozens of identical parts. That meant they were producing at least that many mass-produced ships.

"When I saw it for the first time, I was shocked at how amazing it was. Even if the ships have only half the power of the Coject, if they're mass-produced like this, in dozens of units, the world will soon be completely under Zipple's control."
Diophus seemed to read Jin's mind and whispered.
"Don't worry too much, Diophus Runcandel. I destroyed the finished products with just one breath back then."
Unlike Murakan, who snorted, Jin felt a bit worried.

'I need to analyze the space-time device as soon as possible when I return. I don't know about the Cojecs, but our family needs to have access to mobile summoning device technology or a way to counter it as soon as possible.'
The reason Murakan was able to destroy the Cojecs in Gaipa Kundo with just one breath was not only because his power had recovered to 50%.
It was also due to the fact that the magicians onboard were relatively low-level. The power of the flying ship was affected by the magical power and magic manipulation of its passengers.
If the magicians onboard the mass-produced ships were at the level of the Mangryongdae or the elite of the Jipples, the outcome would have been different.
His chest felt heavy, as if weighed down by a lump of iron.
'...There's no need to be impatient. I just have to catch up. Definitely.'
If he could recover all of Temar's legacy and lift the curse embedded in the family blood, he could regain the old Runcandel's prestige.
"By the way, it's strange that Joshua, my second brother, and the Black Knights didn't notice the information leak at all."

"Are you talking about the operation time? I don't think it's a coincidence that Kinzelo started the terror right now. But there's no way there's a spy among the Black Knights Joshua brought. He would be going crazy worrying about the leak. "
"Is there no possibility that there was a spy among the Execution Knights?"
"No, even if there were, no one among the Execution Knights knew the exact operation time. The control was perfectly executed."
"So, someone must have infiltrated the camp and avoided Joshua, my brother, and the two Black Knights to steal the information."

"It's almost impossible since Joshua had the operation plan with him all the time. Moreover, he never had a moment alone; even when he slept, at least one Black Knight was with him. It's like some ghost came and went..."
Diophus suddenly stopped speaking, as if something came to mind.
At that moment, Jin was also thinking of the same thought and the same name as Diophus.
"No way."
"Yona...?"
Yona Runcandel.
There were very few people in this world who could accomplish such a thing, and Yona was undoubtedly the best among them.
As the two simultaneously thought of their sister-in-law, they felt an inexplicable sense of dread.

"No, wait a minute. Hold on. It can't be Yona. If Yona was involved in this, it would only be because our mother directly entrusted the task to the Nameless. But would our mother have any reason to hide that from Joshua?"
It wasn't impossible for Yona to come here in terms of time.
However, Jin thought that if his sister-in-law had known about the construction site, she would have given him a heads up when she came to look for Tikan.
"No."
"…Then could it be the Nameless King Owl?"
"In my opinion, if the Nameless were involved, it would be more likely the Nameless King than Sister Yona. It wasn't our mother, but Kinzelo who requested the Nameless."

"Right, Yona couldn't be used by the Nameless to leak Runcandel's information, whether it's a request or anything else. If the Nameless King Owl and their top assassins were involved, that would roughly explain it."

Of course, it wasn't a matter that could be concluded hastily. The Nameless, who are maintaining neutrality, don't have many reasons to get involved in such sensitive matters, as long as they don't leave any traces.

"Hmm. Anyway, even if the Nameless were here, they probably won't be involved in this matter any further. Since it doesn't seem like a particularly bad situation for us, we don't need to worry too much."

"That's right. They probably only handed over the operation information to Kinzelo and withdrew. For now, let's move to District 17 and Tower 2. We'll have to check on the other areas as well while we're on the move."
The group began to move, leaving behind the sight of the Red-Tailed Tribe slaughtering the managers of the construction site in District 6.

'But it feels strange somehow. Did she really come...? No, it must be an illusion. Even if she did come, as Diophus said, she would have already returned secretly. Just handing over the information to Kinzelo.'
With an uneasy heart, he opened his senses to the fullest and looked around with heightened awareness, but of course, there was nothing unusual.
Jin could never have imagined that a woman was watching him with a sly smile at his actions.
